summary: Iteration 4 (DatePicker + $group aggregation + LLM 45s timeout) verified end-to-end. Backend: 60/60 pytest pass (~80s) — all prior 59 + 1 new aggregation-correctness test. The new test creates a sentiment record then GETs /api/sentiment/trend?days=1 and asserts today's bucket reflects the new record (total>=1, sentiment count incremented). Trend endpoint contract preserved: days=30 → 30 buckets; days=7 → 7 buckets; days=181/0 → 422; parent → 403; teacher allowed; bucket schema unchanged. Re-raise pattern (`except HTTPException: raise`) confirmed in routes/astrology.py, routes/recommendations.py, routes/sentiment.py (analyze + records) — preserves 504 from asyncio.wait_for timeout in core/llm.py (LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=45). Frontend Playwright: parent register → /dashboard/parent → ChildrenManager card → Add child dialog opens with DialogDescription rendered → child-dob-input is a BUTTON (not native input[type=date]) with calendar icon → click opens shadcn Popover (`child-dob-input-popover`) showing rdp Calendar → day selection populates the button label as a formatted date and saves child to /api/children → DOB badge ('DOB YYYY-MM-DD') visible in children-list. Astrology page (/astrology): astro-dob-input is a BUTTON; clicking opens astro-dob-input-popover with Calendar widget. All preserved testids functional.

issues: Popover positioned at top-left of viewport instead of anchored under the trigger button on a 1440x900 desktop view (the trigger button sits at row containing PLACE OF BIRTH; popover renders above it floating at x≈280,y≈90). Functionally OK, but anchoring/collision-detection looks off — likely because the trigger is inside a dark card container with overflow rules. Worth verifying align/sideOffset/collisionPadding props.

Caption row renders duplicated month/year labels: 'May 2026' header + 'Month: May / May ▾' + 'Year: 2026 / 2026 ▾'. Likely the shadcn Calendar template renders both the dropdown trigger and the static label. Cosmetic but cluttered. ChildrenManager DatePicker has same fromYear/toYear config so likely same issue there.

action_items: (Minor UI) Fix shadcn Calendar caption-dropdown duplicate-label rendering when fromYear/toYear are passed (see DatePicker.jsx + ui/calendar.jsx).
(Minor UI) Tweak Popover positioning on Astrology DOB so it anchors under the trigger button (sideOffset/align/avoidCollisions or move the trigger out of the dark card's overflow-clipped region).
critical_code_review_comments: core/llm.py timeout wrapper is correct: asyncio.wait_for(45s) on chat.send_message raises HTTPException(504). Re-raise pattern in callers (`except HTTPException: raise; except Exception: 502`) properly preserves 504 vs wrapping it as 502.

routes/sentiment.py /trend $group pipeline uses {$substr: ['$created_at', 0, 10]} which assumes ISO-8601 strings — consistent with create_sentiment_record where created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(). Safe given current writes; if any non-ISO writer is added later the bucket date would silently drift. Minor: consider $dateFromString + $dateToString for robustness.

DatePicker.jsx: parses incoming value with date-fns parse('yyyy-MM-dd') — accepts only ISO date strings. Good. fromYear/toYear toggles captionLayout='dropdown' — current shadcn calendar template seems to render duplicate dropdown labels (see design_issues above).
ChildrenManager.jsx: DialogDescription added (resolves prior a11y warning). DatePicker integration clean; submits date_of_birth as YYYY-MM-DD or null.
Carry-over: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is still a misconfig (no current impact since auth uses Bearer header).
